messages:
jordan_support: Customer (AcmeCorp) reporting their finance user cannot view Billing > Usage for tenant `acme-prod` after the RBAC role refactor last week. Deploys still work but billing page shows 'permission denied'.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2784 (auto).

maddy_sec: Can you paste the tenant id + an example user email and the exact error they see? Also need the audit log snippet if possible.

jordan_support: tenant id is t-acme-prod, user is sara@acme.com. Screenshot: "Permission denied: billing.read". Customer said they tried in incognito too.

sam_g: Which auth provider? AAD or GCP? Need the service principal id that does billing reads for that tenant.

harper_infra: Quick grep in audit logs shows repeated denies from svc-acme-billing@redwood-svcs. Log lines: 
```
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z t-acme-prod svc-acme-billing@redwood-svcs denied action=billing.read resource=tenant/t-acme-prod/pipeline/usage policy=role-mapping-v2
2026-03-20T14:02:13Z t-acme-prod svc-acme-billing@redwood-svcs denied action=billing.read resource=tenant/t-acme-prod/dashboard/billing
```

jordan_support: Customer on call rn and asking for ETA. Any quick mitigation?

maddy_sec: Is this the same role-mapping-v2 rollout we did Wed? If so, suspect group->role delegation edge-case. Does svc-acme-billing belong to a group that had delegated roles?

alex_engineer: I ran a quick check — svc-acme-billing is in group `acme-billing-svcs`. That group had a delegated role mapping: group -> delegated-role:billing_view scoped to tenant. Our refactor dropped delegated-role propagation for non-human principals in the v2 mapping layer. Root cause: mapping pipeline filters by principal.type == "user" when expanding delegated roles.

jordan_support: Oof. Can we hotfix mapping and resync roles for acme-prod? Customer needs billing access restored.

alex_engineer: I have a patch ready. Two steps: 1) relax the filter so delegated roles propagate to servicePrincipals too; 2) run rolesync for t-acme-prod (dry-run then apply). I'll push the patch to canary.

harper_infra: Confirming KMS calls are unrelated — no key access errors during these denies. KMS not implicated.

alex_engineer: Pushing patch now, will run rolesync.

oncall-bot: Deploy started by alex_engineer to canary (deploy-3982).

alex_engineer: Patch deployed to canary. Running rolesync: `./scripts/rolesync --tenant t-acme-prod --apply`

harper_infra: Rolesync logs: 
```
[INFO] expanding group acme-billing-svcs -> delegated-role:billing_view -> granting billing.read to svc-acme-billing@redwood-svcs
[OK] 1 principal updated
```

jordan_support: Customer confirms Sara can now see Billing > Usage. Access restored at 14:18 UTC.

maddy_sec: Good. Please open a postmortem documenting the regression, root cause (user-only filter), and add a unit + integration test to prevent delegation being filtered by principal type. Assign owners for follow-ups.

sam_g: I'll create a ticket in the backlog: RBAC-1265 add tests + rollout checklist. Recommend a quick audit to list other tenants with delegated roles and non-human principals.

harper_infra: Ran query — ~12 tenants have groups with delegated roles and service principals. Will schedule batch resync and notify impacted customers before we apply.

maddy_sec: Also add an audit log alert for repeated billing.read denies for service principals over 5 mins.

jordan_support: Notifying Acme that this was a code issue on our side and we've restored access; offering follow-up call. Customer appreciated the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

alex_engineer: Patch merged to main and hotfix rolled to prod. Will follow up with PR link and postmortem draft in #postmortems.

maddy_sec: Thanks team. Closing incident once postmortem is posted and the regression tests are green.
